head.t: J&J to install first Ottava robot in US hospital
head.x: Memorial Hermann-Texas Medical Center will be the first US hospital to install Johnson & Johnson's Ottava soft tissue surgical robot, whose four arms are built into a standard operating table.

head.t: J&J pays $2.2B upfront for Ollin to challenge Roche’s Vabysmo
head.x: Johnson & Johnson is buying Ollin Biosciences for $2.2bn upfront, giving it a phase 3 bispecific eye disease drug to compete with Roche’s Vabysmo.

head.t: Smith+Nephew confirms talks with Johnson & Johnson over DePuy Synthes have ended and cuts its 2026 outlook
head.x: In its third-quarter update on 04/11/2026, Smith+Nephew said it approached Johnson & Johnson earlier in the year about a possible combination with DePuy Synthes, that discussions took place and have now ended. Its Board will keep exploring strategic options for the Orthopaedics business.

head.t: J&J EP leader Michael Bodner offers a PFA program update
head.x: Johnson & Johnson MedTech's electrophysiology chair discusses its pulsed field ablation portfolio after the April 2026 Varipulse Pro launch, aiming for the most complete PFA range on the market.

f.t: Abbott and J&J report coronary intravascular lithotripsy trial results
f.x: Separate Abbott and Johnson & Johnson MedTech studies of coronary IVL, presented at TCT, showed low complication rates at 30 days and mostly successful lesion crossing.

f.t: J&J reports real-world Varipulse Pro data and 12-month Omnypulse outcomes at APHRS 2026
f.x: Johnson & Johnson (J&J) has announced new data from the VARIPURE and Omny-IRE studies presented at the 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) annual meeting (21–24 October, Busan, South Korea). Both studies were published simultaneously in Europace and Heart Rhythm, respectively.
